title: AO/194/2012 of KASIM and ANOTHER Vs MEHAL SINGH and OTHERS

paras.text:
CLMA 11219/2012
 in
 A.O. No. 194/2012
Hon'ble B.S. Verma, J.

Heard Sri Neeraj Upreti Advocate for
the claimants/respondents on money
withdrawal application.
The claimant/respondent is permitted to
withdraw 50% of the amount deposited
amount of the award with the MACT
concerned.
The money withdrawal application
stands disposed of.
